data.name: Star Hero
data.detailed_description:
In Star Hero, you are a lone pilot in a sector of space that wants you gone. This is a pure, skill-based 2D shooter where your only objective is survival. But you aren't just fighting to stay alive—you're fighting to become the ultimate weapon.

Key Features:

  • 360° Combat Freedom: Fly and aim in any direction. Total control over your ship means every dodge and every shot depends entirely on your reflexes.

  • Upgrade Your Arsenal: Every enemy destroyed grants you points. Use your hard-earned score to purchase vital ship upgrades, increasing your firepower, speed, and survivability as the chaos intensifies.

  • Unrelenting Hostile Waves: Enemies warp in from all sides, forcing you to stay mobile and keep your cannons hot. There is nowhere to hide in the vastness of space.

  • Scaling Difficulty: The universe grows more dangerous every minute. As you survive, the opposition becomes faster and more numerous, testing the limits of your upgraded ship.

  • Pure Arcade Experience: Designed for quick, intense sessions. Perfect for players who love the "just one more run" loop.

How long can you survive against the odds?

Single player mode is currently available. Online or multiplayer features may be added, changed or removed at any time.

data.short_description: Star Hero is a 2D space arena shooter where every kill counts. Survive against endless waves of enemies, earn points for every destruction, and use them to upgrade your ship’s power. The void grows more dangerous every minute—how long can you hold the line?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240, AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1GB), Radeon HD 7750 (1GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2GB), Radeon R9 380 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
